(rule! (lambda (g)
 (let* ((ph (quotient (- (rows g) 1) 2)) (w (cols g)) (off (- (rows g) ph))
        (tn (for*/sum ((r (range 0 ph)) (c (range 0 w))) (if (and (!= (at g r c) 0) (= (at g (+ off r) c) 0)) 1 0))) (bn (for*/sum ((r (range 0 ph)) (c (range 0 w))) (if (= (at g (+ off r) c) 0) 0 1)))
        (choose-top (> tn bn)))
  (build-grid ph w (r c)
   (let ((top (at g r c)) (bot (at g (+ off r) c)))
    (if choose-top (if (!= top 0) top bot) (if (!= bot 0) bot top)))))))

intermediate: The two panel occupancy counts and their input-dependent comparison, including the lower-panel tie convention.
step_a: Extract the aligned panels and count the occupied cells in each panel before overlay.
step_b: Choose the denser or sparser panel according to the episode policy, then use that selected panel at every true overlap while preserving sole-occupancy cells and blanks.
why_b_depends_on_a: The same local overlap pair can have either output color when distant occupancy changes the panel counts. Counting after a preliminary lower overlay erases upper evidence and can reverse the comparison; the selected overlay operation therefore requires the unoccluded counts.
